lines.text: Jesus denounced the cities where most of His miracles were done, saying woe to Chorazin and Bethsaida.
Jesus said Tyre and Sidon would have repented long ago, and judgment would be more bearable for them.
Jesus said Capernaum would be brought down to Egypt, and judgment would be more bearable for Sodom than for it.
Jesus praised the Father for hiding these things from the wise and learned and revealing them to kings.
Jesus invited the weary and burdened to come to Him for rest, saying His yoke is easy.
